hooks.name: Block credentials in workspace files
hooks.description: NFR-01 guard: refuses any file write that contains something shaped like an AWS access key, secret key, session token or private key.

action.command: input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eq '(AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}|AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=["'"'"']?[A-Za-z0-9/+]{30,}|AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=["'"'"']?[A-Za-z0-9/+=]{40,}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----'; then echo 'Blocked by BridgeX security hook: this content looks like an AWS credential or a private key. Keep secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or your shell environment, never in workspace files.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
